## Gap ID
EXT-007

## Source
gap-analysis-byos-extensibility

## Description
The `BaseAlgorithm.observe()` method is defined but never called by the `Campaign` class after simulation results. Iterative algorithms (DE, DA, PSO, NSGA-II) that need to observe results and generate new samples cannot function correctly.

## Evidence
- `osimflow/algorithms/__init__.py` — `BaseAlgorithm.observe()` exists
- `osimflow/campaign.py` — no calls to `algorithm.observe()`
- Issue #270 tracks this

## Severity
Critical

## Recommended Mitigation
Wire `algorithm.observe()` into the Campaign's iterative loop. The Campaign must call `observe()` after each generation's KPI extraction and pass the updated sample set back to `generate_samples()`.

## Labels
gap-analysis, algorithms, iterative, campaign, critical
